# Introduction

Linear mixed-effects models are used to test whether Age, W0_BMI, and W0_MGIT (Mtb burden)
are associated with PET/CT volumes at W0, W4, W16, and W24, and whether
these associations differ between visits. Each predictor is tested
independently against each outcome. A threshold of p < 0.05 is
used to identify significant effects. 

Figure 5A: Age and treatment effect on total cavity volume (CAVTOT, mL) and
total lesion glycolysis (TLG, mL).

Figure 5D: W0_BMI and treatment effect on total cavity volume (CAVTOT, mL) and
total lesion glycolysis (TLG, mL).

Figure 5E: W0_MGIT Mtb burden and treatment effect on total cavity volume
(CAVTOT, mL) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG, mL).

For each predictor and outcome a model of the form
`outcome ~ Visit * Predictor + covariates + (1|ID1)` is fitted. Age is
adjusted for Sex and trial Arm only. BMI and MGIT are adjusted for Age, Sex,
and trial Arm. The interaction term tests whether the association between the
predictor and imaging volume differs between visits. Demographics are
patient-level variables so the analysis uses one record per patient from the
Null condition.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
input_file  <- "Input/Demographic and clinical information.xlsx"
input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/05. Figure_5A_5D_5E"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(Previous_TB = ifelse(Previous_TB == "0 episode", "No", "Yes"))

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(Visit = paste0("W", Visit))

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)
```

# Filter and recode

Demographics are extracted from the Null condition to obtain one unique record
per patient. Because demographics do not change between visits, the join is by
ID1 only and the PET/CT data contributes the visit structure.

```{r}
demo_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Age         = as.numeric(Age),
    BMI_0         = as.numeric(BMI_0),
    MGIT_0        = as.numeric(MGIT_0),
    Previous_TB = factor(Previous_TB, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Sex         = factor(Sex,         levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Arm         = factor(Arm,         levels = c("A", "B", "C"))
  ) %>%
  select(ID1, Age, Sex, Arm, BMI_0, MGIT_0) %>%
  distinct()

cat(sprintf("Patients with demographic data: %d\n", nrow(demo_data)))
cat(sprintf(
  "Age range: %.0f - %.0f | Sex: %s | Arm: %s\n",
  min(demo_data$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(demo_data$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
  paste(levels(demo_data$Sex), collapse = ", "),
  paste(levels(demo_data$Arm), collapse = ", ")
))
```

# Merge demographics and PET/CT data

```{r}
analysis_data <- pet_data %>%
  left_join(demo_data, by = "ID1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(TLG))

cat(sprintf("Merged rows: %d | Samples with CAVTOT: %d | TLG: %d\n",
            nrow(analysis_data),
            sum(!is.na(analysis_data$CAVTOT)),
            sum(!is.na(analysis_data$TLG))))
```

# Log transform imaging variables

CAVTOT and TLG are log10(1 + x) transformed to handle zero values safely.

```{r}
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + CAVTOT),
    TLG    = log10(1 + TLG)
  )
```

# Analysis configuration

`predictor_config` defines each variable, its covariates, x-axis unit, figure
label, and the exact caption formula displayed in each plot. `outcome_config`
defines the two imaging outcomes.

```{r}
predictor_config <- list(

  Age = list(
    variable        = "Age",
    label           = "Age",
    covariates      = c("Sex", "Arm"),
    unit            = "years",
    caption_formula = "LME: outcome ~ Visit * Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)"
  ),

  BMI_0 = list(
    variable        = "BMI_0",
    label           = "W0 BMI",
    covariates      = c("Age", "Sex", "Arm"),
    unit            = "kg/m2",
    caption_formula = "LME: outcome ~ Visit * BMI_0 + Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)"
  ),

  MGIT_0 = list(
    variable        = "MGIT_0",
    label           = "W0 MGIT Mtb burden",
    covariates      = c("Age", "Sex", "Arm"),
    unit            = "",
    caption_formula = "LME: outcome ~ Visit * MGIT_0 + Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)"
  )
)

outcome_config <- list(

  CAVTOT = list(
    outcome      = "CAVTOT",
    label        = "Total cavity volume (log10 mL)",
    min_obs      = 10,
    min_subjects = 5
  ),

  TLG = list(
    outcome      = "TLG",
    label        = "Total lesion glycolysis (log10 mL)",
    min_obs      = 10,
    min_subjects = 5
  )
)

cat("predictor_config entries:", paste(names(predictor_config), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("outcome_config entries:",   paste(names(outcome_config),   collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
visit_colors <- c("W0" = "#000000", "W4" = "orange", "W16" = "#00CCFF", "W24" = "purple")
```

# LME screening function

`screen_lme`: fits `outcome ~ Visit * Predictor_Value + covariates + (1|ID1)`
for one predictor and one outcome. Returns Wald chi-square p-values for the
Visit main effect, predictor main effect, and interaction. Returns NULL if
data are insufficient.

```{r}
screen_lme <- function(data, predictor_name, outcome,
                       covariates   = NULL,
                       min_obs      = 10,
                       min_subjects = 5) {

  keep_cols <- unique(c("ID1", "Visit", outcome, predictor_name, covariates))

  dat <- data %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
           !is.na(.data[[predictor_name]])) %>%
    rename(Predictor_Value = all_of(predictor_name)) %>%
    mutate(
      Predictor_Value = if (is.factor(Predictor_Value)) {
                          as.numeric(Predictor_Value) - 1
                        } else {
                          as.numeric(Predictor_Value)
                        },
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1),
      Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W4", "W16", "W24"))
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < min_obs || n_distinct(dat$ID1) < min_subjects) return(NULL)

  covariate_terms <- if (!is.null(covariates)) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else NULL
  formula_str     <- paste(
    outcome, "~ Visit * Predictor_Value",
    if (!is.null(covariate_terms)) paste("+", covariate_terms),
    "+ (1|ID1)"
  )

  tryCatch({
    model     <- lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- Anova(model, type = 3)

    data.frame(
      Predictor     = predictor_name,
      Visit_p       = anova_res["Visit",                 "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      Predictor_p   = anova_res["Predictor_Value",       "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      Interaction_p = anova_res["Visit:Predictor_Value", "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      N_obs         = nrow(dat),
      N_subjects    = n_distinct(dat$ID1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("LME failed for ", predictor_name, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}
```

# P-value formatting helper

```{r}
format_p <- function(p) {
  stars <- if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else ""
  label <- if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
  paste0(label, stars)
}
```

# LME plot function

`plot_lme`: fits the same model as `screen_lme` and generates a scatter plot
with LME-predicted regression lines per visit and 95% confidence bands from
emmeans. Raw p-values with significance stars are shown in the subtitle.
Regression equations are annotated in the top right corner. The caption
formula is taken from `predictor_config` and displayed exactly as specified.

```{r}
plot_lme <- function(data, predictor_name, predictor_label, predictor_unit,
                     outcome, outcome_label, caption_formula,
                     visit_colors, covariates = NULL, save_path = NULL) {

  keep_cols <- unique(c("ID1", "Visit", outcome, predictor_name, covariates))

  dat <- data %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
           !is.na(.data[[predictor_name]])) %>%
    rename(Predictor_Value = all_of(predictor_name)) %>%
    mutate(
      Predictor_Value = if (is.factor(Predictor_Value)) {
                          as.numeric(Predictor_Value) - 1
                        } else {
                          as.numeric(Predictor_Value)
                        },
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1),
      Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W4", "W16", "W24"))
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || n_distinct(dat$ID1) < 5) return(invisible(NULL))

  covariate_terms <- if (!is.null(covariates)) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else NULL
  formula_str     <- paste(
    outcome, "~ Visit * Predictor_Value",
    if (!is.null(covariate_terms)) paste("+", covariate_terms),
    "+ (1|ID1)"
  )

  model <- tryCatch(
    lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) return(invisible(NULL))

  anova_res     <- Anova(model, type = 3)
  visit_p       <- anova_res["Visit",                 "Pr(>Chisq)"]
  predictor_p   <- anova_res["Predictor_Value",       "Pr(>Chisq)"]
  interaction_p <- anova_res["Visit:Predictor_Value", "Pr(>Chisq)"]

  pred_seq <- seq(
    min(dat$Predictor_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat$Predictor_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  )

  pred <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans(model, ~ Visit * Predictor_Value,
            at = list(Predictor_Value = pred_seq))
  )

  coefs         <- fixef(model)
  intercept_w0  <- coefs["(Intercept)"]
  slope_w0      <- coefs["Predictor_Value"]

  intercept_w4  <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW4" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW4"], 0)
  slope_w4      <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW4:Predictor_Value" %in% names(coefs),
           coefs["VisitW4:Predictor_Value"], 0)

  intercept_w16 <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW16" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW16"], 0)
  slope_w16     <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW16:Predictor_Value" %in% names(coefs),
           coefs["VisitW16:Predictor_Value"], 0)

  intercept_w24 <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW24" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW24"], 0)
  slope_w24     <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW24:Predictor_Value" %in% names(coefs),
           coefs["VisitW24:Predictor_Value"], 0)

  visits_present <- levels(droplevels(dat$Visit))

  eq_lines <- c()
  if ("W0"  %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W0:  y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w0,  ifelse(intercept_w0  >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w0)))
  if ("W4"  %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W4:  y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w4,  ifelse(intercept_w4  >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w4)))
  if ("W16" %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W16: y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w16, ifelse(intercept_w16 >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w16)))
  if ("W24" %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W24: y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w24, ifelse(intercept_w24 >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w24)))

  eq_label <- paste(eq_lines, collapse = "\n")

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = Predictor_Value, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = Visit),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = Predictor_Value, y = emmean, color = Visit),
      linewidth = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = Predictor_Value, y = .data[[outcome]], color = Visit),
      alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf, label = eq_label,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.2,
      fontface = "italic", color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = visit_colors, name = "Visit") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = visit_colors, name = "Visit") +
    labs(
      title    = predictor_label,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Visit: ",       format_p(visit_p),     "  |  ",
        "Predictor: ",   format_p(predictor_p), "  |  ",
        "Interaction: ", format_p(interaction_p)
      ),
      x       = paste0(predictor_label, " (", predictor_unit, ")"),
      y       = outcome_label,
      caption = caption_formula
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major    = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.minor    = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2)
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      file.path(save_path,
                paste0(predictor_name, "_LME_", outcome, ".pdf")),
      plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in"
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Run all analyses

For each outcome, each predictor is tested independently.

```{r}
all_analyses <- list()

for (outcome_name in names(outcome_config)) {
  out_cfg <- outcome_config[[outcome_name]]
  out_dir <- file.path(output_main, outcome_name)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cat(sprintf("\nOutcome: %s\n", out_cfg$label))

  screening_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(predictor_config), function(pred_name) {
    pred_cfg <- predictor_config[[pred_name]]
    screen_lme(
      data           = analysis_data,
      predictor_name = pred_cfg$variable,
      outcome        = out_cfg$outcome,
      covariates     = pred_cfg$covariates,
      min_obs        = out_cfg$min_obs,
      min_subjects   = out_cfg$min_subjects
    )
  }))

  if (nrow(screening_results) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  No results for %s. Skipping.\n", outcome_name))
    next
  }

  cat(sprintf("  Predictors screened: %d\n", nrow(screening_results)))

  screening_results <- screening_results %>%
    mutate(
      Visit_sig       = Visit_p       < 0.05,
      Predictor_sig   = Predictor_p   < 0.05,
      Interaction_sig = Interaction_p < 0.05,
      Any_sig         = Visit_sig | Predictor_sig | Interaction_sig
    ) %>%
    arrange(Interaction_p)

  cat(sprintf(
    "  Significant (p < 0.05): Visit = %d | Predictor = %d | Interaction = %d\n",
    sum(screening_results$Visit_sig,       na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(screening_results$Predictor_sig,   na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(screening_results$Interaction_sig, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

  write_xlsx(screening_results, file.path(out_dir, "LME_screening_results.xlsx"))

  for (pred_name in names(predictor_config)) {
  pred_cfg <- predictor_config[[pred_name]]

  plot_lme(
    data            = analysis_data,
    predictor_name  = pred_cfg$variable,
    predictor_label = pred_cfg$label,
    predictor_unit  = pred_cfg$unit,
    outcome         = out_cfg$outcome,
    outcome_label   = out_cfg$label,
    caption_formula = pred_cfg$caption_formula,
    visit_colors    = visit_colors,
    covariates      = pred_cfg$covariates,
    save_path       = out_dir                            
  )
}

  summary_table <- screening_results %>%
    select(
      Predictor, N_obs, N_subjects,
      Visit_p, Visit_sig,
      Predictor_p, Predictor_sig,
      Interaction_p, Interaction_sig, Any_sig
    )

  write_xlsx(summary_table, file.path(out_dir, "LME_summary_table.xlsx"))

  all_analyses[[outcome_name]] <- list(
  screening_results  = screening_results,
  predictors_plotted = names(predictor_config)           
)
}
```
